name: Kurihara Hidemitsu
source:
Mariko's husband.

He is an active international pilot. He enjoys fishing, golf, bonsai, and Go.

He loves drinking and partying.

He is happy to find a friend (Takashi) who is willing to go out with him. Four years ago, he broke his long bachelorhood and asked Mariko to marry him.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/buai.html] official site]
